name: re-entrant corner: uniform vs graded h-refinement, p- and hp-refinement (Professor Rabczuk, 27 Nov)
problem: exact L-shape of lshape_exact.py: 270-degree free/free corner, exact Williams field (lam1 = 0.5445, lam2 = 0.9085) imposed on the outer edges; plane strain E = 1000, nu = 0.3
measure: relative energy-norm error ||u - u_h||_E / ||u||_E computed with the exact stresses by quadrature; rates beta in e ~ N^(-beta), N = number of DOF, least squares over the finest three levels

families.U1: uniform, Q1 (ElementQuad1), n = 4..64 per unit square
families.G2_1.5: tensor grading toward x = 1 and y = 1 (nodes s^g), g = 1.5, Q2
families.P: p-version: fixed uniform mesh n = 2, element degree p = 1..8 (ElementQuadP)
families.HP: hp: geometric mesh toward the corner lines (ratio sigma = 0.15, m layers), uniform degree p = m, m = 1..6

theory.uniform h: e ~ h^min(p, lam) = N^(-min(p, lam)/2) [Strang & Fix 1973; Babuska & Kellogg 1979]
theory.graded h, nodes s^g: e ~ n^(-min(p, g lam)) = N^(-min(p, g lam)/2); optimal order p needs g >= p / lam [Babuska, Kellogg & Pitkaranta 1979; Apel 1999]
theory.p-version on a fixed quasi-uniform mesh: e ~ p^(-2 lam) = N^(-lam) (twice the h-version rate) [Babuska & Suri 1987]
theory.hp on geometric meshes: exponential: e ~ exp(-b N^(1/3)) in 2D [Babuska & Guo 1986; Schwab 1998]

R1_uniform.text: Q1 and Q2 have the same uniform rate lam/2 = 0.272: the higher degree does not help

R2_graded.text: g = 1.5 is not enough for Q2 (beta 0.41), g = 2 restores Q1 (beta 0.5), g = 4 >= 2 / lam = 3.67 restores Q2 (beta 1.0)

R3_p.text: p-version rate lam = 0.544, twice the uniform h-version rate

R4_hp.text: log e is linear in N^(1/3) over the last three points (R^2 >= 0.98) and the finest hp error is below the finest error of every other family

R5_order_of_families.text: at the finest level: HP < G2_4 < U2 in error, and HP uses the fewest DOF

consequence_for_the_agent: the agent's own intensity grading gave order ~2 for the strain energy with Q2 (apriori_score.json G1); this study fixes how strong the grading must be for p = 2
